book.name: 2 Tetsarunikatari
book.title: Xapa hutarieka mieme Papuru kemɨtiwarunɨ'airi Tetsarunikatari

content: tekanixewaɨritɨaka tetsarunikatari xemɨyutixexeɨriwa Kakaɨyari mɨta'ukiyari hetsie xetewiyatɨ, Ti'aitame Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu hetsie xetewiyatɨ.
Kakaɨyari mɨta'ukiyari, Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu mɨti'aitame, 'aixɨa mekete'u'iyarini xehetsiemieme, mekexepitɨaka yu'iyaritsie xemɨka'uximatɨariekakɨ.

Neuxei 'iwamarixi, kaneuyeweka tame taheyemekɨ pamɨpariyutsi temipitɨakakɨ Kakaɨyari xehepaɨtsita, kemɨreuyewetse yatemɨteyuriekakɨ xeme keyuri xemɨte'erie xemɨtaweriyarɨmekɨ, meta yuxexuitɨ yunaitɨ xemɨtetamɨiriyarɨmekɨ xeteyukanaki'erietɨ.

'Ayumieme tameri 'aixɨa te'utiyuatɨ xehepaɨtsita yatekateniwakuxaxatɨwani mɨkɨ memɨyutixexeɨriwa Kakaɨyari hetsie metewiyatɨ, mɨpaɨ teteniwakɨhɨaweni, kexemɨte'uka'eniwa, yuri kexemɨte'erie mexi xetaweweiyarɨwa, mexi xe'uximatɨarie, meta naime kexemɨ'itɨarietɨwe.

Yaxe'itɨariekaku kanimatsiɨkɨni Kakaɨyari heitseriemekɨ kemɨti'inɨata 'itsɨkametɨtɨ, mɨpaɨ xeteta'inɨatsieme xemeta xekanimariwakakuni, xehetsie kemɨtinakeni 'axemu'uwanikɨ Kakaɨyari tixe'aitɨwametɨkaku, mɨpaɨ mɨtiyɨnikɨ xetenikwineni xemeta.
Kamɨtsɨ, Kakaɨyari heitseriemekɨ katiniyuriemɨkɨ kemɨtiwapinirieni wa'uximatɨatɨ mɨkɨ memɨxe'uximatɨa,

kemɨtixepinirieni xemeta xe'uxipitɨatɨ xeme xemɨ'uximatɨarie, yatati'uxipitɨatɨ tameta, kepauka matsiɨkɨtɨ mayani Ti'aitame Ketsutsi taheima 'akamietɨ, yuniuki tuayamete memɨtɨrɨkawi wahamatɨa 'akamietɨ, taipaɨ merɨkaɨyetɨ.
Heitseriemekɨ kaniwaranutaxɨriemɨkɨ mɨkɨ memɨka'imate Kakaɨyari, mɨkɨ yamemɨkatekahu Tati'aitɨwame Ketsutsi niukieya 'aixɨa manuyɨne hetsie.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ memɨ'anene kememɨte'anutaxɨriyani, wahetsie tininakimɨkɨ memɨka'unarienikɨ yuheyemekɨ, Ti'aitame hɨxieya mekaxeiyatɨ meta tɨrɨkaɨyetɨ kemɨtimariwe meka'ixeiyatɨ

kepauka munuani, kaninuamɨkɨtsɨ witsimɨtixeiyarienikɨ yuteɨterima wahetsie tiwiyatɨ, yunaitɨ yuri memɨte'uta'eri memɨhɨxiyanikɨ me'i'ixɨarietɨ 'iya tukaritsie, mɨpaɨ katiniyɨmɨkɨ yuri xemɨte'ita'eririkɨ tita temɨtehekɨatakai xehetsɨa.

Mɨpaɨ mɨtiyɨnikɨ, xehetsiemieme tekanitanenewieka taheyemekɨ, takakaɨyari mɨpaɨ mɨtixemaikakɨ xeme xe'u'uwame kemɨreuyewetse 'amuyeikanikɨ Kakaɨyari 'ita'inieyu, tepɨtanenewieta takakaɨyari yɨtɨrɨkariyakɨ meye'atɨanikɨ naime kexemɨteyuwaɨriya 'aixɨa xeteyuriekutɨ, naime kexemɨteyurie yuri xete'erietɨ.

Mɨpaɨ tiyɨyu, kemɨ'ane Tati'aitɨwame Ketsutsi mɨhɨkɨ witsikatinixeiyariemɨkɨ xehetsie tiwiyatɨ, xemeta witsixekatenixeiyariekuni hetsiena xetewiyatɨ, takakaɨyari Tati'aitɨwame Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu 'aixɨa mɨtiuka'iyarikɨ.
